sites.name: Arizoba Mine
overview: Arizoba Mine is a named historic copper mine preserved on USGS-derived King Creek mapping in Grand County.

timeline.text: USGS-derived mapping preserves Arizoba as a named inactive copper mine.

sites.name: Big Dike Lode
overview: Big Dike Lode is a named Grand County mine feature preserved on USGS-derived Radial Mountain mapping.

timeline.text: Federal mapping preserves Big Dike Lode as a named mine feature.

sites.name: Blue Ridge Mine
overview: Blue Ridge Mine is a federally recorded Grand County copper site with a stable mapped mine location.

timeline.text: USGS MRDS preserves Blue Ridge as a named copper mine locality.

sites.name: Cozens Ranch House & Stage Stop
overview: Cozens Ranch House is a surviving 1874 Fraser Valley ranch and historic stage-stop building.

timeline.text: The ranch developed into a stage stop and early Fraser Valley post office.

sites.name: Moffat Tunnel West Portal / West Portal Construction Camp
overview: The Moffat Tunnel West Portal is the verified Grand County western entrance to the historic Moffat railroad tunnel near Winter Park.

timeline.text: Construction culminated in the completed Moffat Tunnel and railroad service through the Continental Divide.
